SELECT 
    pp.id AS id,
    pp.default_code AS product_code,
    pt.name AS name,
    pt.description AS description,
    pc.complete_name AS product_category_hierarchy,
    pt.type AS product_type,
    pt.list_price AS unit_price,
   	ir.value_float AS unit_cost,
    pb.name AS product_brand,
    pit.name AS item_type,
    ppcv.name AS product_classification_status,
    ppcv2.name AS product_classification_1,
    ppcv3.name AS product_classification_grade,
    pt2.name AS successor_model_product,
    pp.is_combo_item,
	pp.source_system_code as source_system_code
FROM stg_product_product pp
LEFT JOIN stg_product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_category pc ON pt.categ_id = pc.id
LEFT JOIN stg_ir_property ir ON  CONCAT('product.template,', pt.id::text) = ir.res_id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_brand pb ON pt.brand_id = pb.id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_item_type pit ON pt.item_type_id = pit.id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_product_classification_value ppcv ON pp.product_classification_status_id = ppcv.id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_product_classification_value ppcv2 ON pp.product_classification_1_id = ppcv2.id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_product_classification_value ppcv3 ON pp.product_classification_grade_id = ppcv3.id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_product pp2 ON pp.successor_model_product_id = pp2.id
LEFT JOIN stg_product_template pt2 ON pp2.product_tmpl_id = pt2.id;

select rc.id as id, rc.currency_unit_label as name, rc."name" as abbreviation, rc.source_system_code  as source_system_code 
from stg_res_currency rc ;

select sol.id as order_line_id, so.id as order_id, so.currency_id as  currency_id, so.partner_id as customer_id, so.warehouse_id as warehouse_id, so.employee_id as employee_id,
sol.product_id as product_id, sol.product_uom as product_uom, sol.company_branch_id as company_branch_id,
so.name as order_name, sol.name as order_line_name, rc."name" as current_currency,
so.commitment_date as request_delivery_date, so.date_order as date_order_id, so.ecommerce_order_code as sale_order_code,
so.global_discount_type as order_discount_type, so.global_order_discount as original_order_discount, so.last_date_invoice as invoice_date,
so.validity_date as expiration_date, so.amount_untaxed as original_order_untaxed_amount, so.amount_tax as original_order_tax_amount,
so.total_discount as original_order_total_amount, sol.discount_type as order_line_discount_type, sol.discount as original_order_line_discount,
sol.is_downpayment as is_downpayment, sol.price_tax as original_order_line_tax_amount, sol.price_unit as original_unit_price,
sol.product_uom_qty as quantity, sol.price_subtotal as original_order_line_price_subtotal, apt.name as payment_term, pp.name as pricelist,
case
	WHEN aaa.name LIKE 'RT%' THEN 'Retail'
    when aaa.name like 'PE%' then 'Retail'
    WHEN aaa.name LIKE 'WS%' THEN 'Whole-Sale'
    WHEN aaa.name LIKE 'B2B%' THEN 'B2B'
    ELSE 'Other'
end as business_unit, sol.source_system_code as source_system_code
from stg_sale_order_line sol
left join stg_sale_order so on sol.order_id = so.id
left join stg_res_currency rc on so.currency_id = rc.id
left join stg_account_payment_term apt on so.payment_term_id = apt.id
left join stg_product_pricelist pp on so.pricelist_id = pp.id
left join stg_account_analytic_account aaa on so.analytic_account_id = aaa.id
where so.state = 'done' and sol.is_downpayment != true and sol.is_reward_line != true;

select rcb.id as id, rcb.name as name, rcb.code as code, rcb2.name as parent_branch, rcb.fullname as full_name,
rcb.source_system_code as source_system_code
from stg_res_company_branch rcb
left join stg_res_company_branch rcb2 on rcb.parent_id = rcb2.id;

SELECT 
	uu.id as id,
    uu.name AS name,
    uc.name AS uom_type,
    uu.factor as conversion_factor,
    base_uu.name AS base_uom,
    uu.active as active,
    uu.source_system_code as source_system_code
FROM 
    stg_uom_uom uu
JOIN 
    stg_uom_uom base_uu 
    ON uu.category_id = base_uu.category_id 
    AND base_uu.uom_type = 'reference'
JOIN 
    stg_uom_category uc 
    ON uu.category_id = uc.id
ORDER BY 
    uc.name, uu.name;

select he.id as id, he.name as name, he.code as code, he.fname as firstname, he.lname as lastname, he.name_full as fullname, he.staff_type as staff_type,
he.work_phone as phone, he.work_email as email, rcb.name as branch, he.working_date as start_date, hd.name as department, hj.name as job_position,
hjg.name as job_grade, he.active as active, he.source_system_code as source_system_code
from stg_hr_employee he
left join stg_res_company_branch rcb on he.company_branch_id = rcb.id
left join stg_hr_department hd on he.department_id = hd.id
left join stg_hr_job hj on he.job_title_id = hj.id
left join stg_hr_jobs_grade hjg on he.job_id = hjg.id;

select sw.id as id, sw.name as name, sw.active as active, sw.code as code, rp.contact_address_complete as warehouse_address,
rp2.name as warehouse_province, rd.name as warehouse_district, rc.name as warehouse_commune, rv.name as warehouse_village,
rp.postcode as warehouse_postcode, rp.partner_latitude as latitude, rp.partner_longitude as longitude, sw.source_system_code as source_system_code
from stg_stock_warehouse sw 
left join stg_res_partner rp on sw.partner_id = rp.id
left join stg_resource_province rp2 on rp.province_id = rp2.id
left join stg_resource_district rd on rp.district_id = rd.id
left join stg_resource_commune rc on rp.commune_id = rc.id
left join stg_resource_village rv on rp.village_id = rv.id;

select sso.id as order_id, sso."name" as order_name, ssol.id as order_line_id, ssol."name" as order_line_name,
sso.currency_id as  currency_id, sso.partner_id as customer_id, sso.warehouse_id as warehouse_id, 
sso.employee_id as employee_id, ssol.product_id as product_id, ssol.product_uom as product_uom, ssol.company_branch_id as company_branch_id,
src."name" as local_currency, sso.invoice_status as invoice_status, sso.state as order_state, sso.commitment_date as request_delivery_date,
sso.customer_note as customer_note, sso.date_order as date_order_id, sso.effective_date as actual_ship_date, sso.last_date_invoice as invoice_date,
sso.validity_date as expiration_date, sso.amount_total as original_total_order_amount, 
ssol.product_uom_qty as quantity, ssol.qty_delivered as qty_delivered, ssol.qty_invoiced as qty_invoiced, ssol.qty_returned as qty_returned,
ssol.return_date as return_date, ssol.price_subtotal as original_order_line_price_subtotal, sapt."name" as payment_term, spp."name" as pricelist,
sso.picking_policy as shipping_policy, 
case
	WHEN saaa.name LIKE 'RT%' THEN 'Retail'
    when saaa.name like 'PE%' then 'Retail'
    WHEN saaa.name LIKE 'WS%' THEN 'Whole-Sale'
    WHEN saaa.name LIKE 'B2B%' THEN 'B2B'
    ELSE 'Other'
end as business_unit, sso.source_system_code as source_system_code
from stg_sale_order_line ssol 
left join stg_sale_order sso on sso.id = ssol.order_id
left join stg_res_currency src on sso.currency_id = src.id
left join stg_account_payment_term sapt on sso.payment_term_id = sapt.id
left join stg_product_pricelist spp on sso.pricelist_id = spp.id
left join stg_account_analytic_account saaa on sso.analytic_account_id = saaa.id
where ssol.is_downpayment != true and ssol.is_reward_line != true;

SELECT 
    rp.id AS id,
    rp.name AS name,
    rp.firstname AS firstname,
    rp.lastname,
    rpt.name AS title,
    rp.contact_address_complete AS address,
    rc.name AS country,
    rp.email_normalized AS email,
    rp.phone_sanitized AS phone,
    rp2.name AS province,
    rd.name AS district,
    rc2.name AS commune,
    rv.name AS village,
    rp.postcode AS postcode,
    rp.partner_latitude AS latitude,
    rp.partner_longitude AS longitude,
    rp.married_status AS maritial_status,
    rp.dob AS dob,
    rp.gender AS gender,
    rp.source_system_code AS source_system_code
FROM stg_res_partner rp
LEFT JOIN stg_res_partner_title rpt ON rp.title = rpt.name
LEFT JOIN stg_res_country rc ON rp.country_id = rc.id
LEFT JOIN stg_resource_province rp2 ON rp.province_id = rp2.id
LEFT JOIN stg_resource_district rd ON rp.district_id = rd.id
LEFT JOIN stg_resource_commune rc2 ON rp.commune_id = rc2.id
LEFT JOIN stg_resource_village rv ON rp.village_id = rv.id;
